_help: Edit this file to change the SAM.gov search. Empty list = no filter on that field. Matching is case-insensitive.
_agencies_help: Matched against the agency path (e.g. 'STATE, DEPARTMENT OF / STATE, DEPARTMENT OF / US EMBASSY KAMPALA'). You can also list sub-offices like 'US EMBASSY', 'ARMY', 'DLA', 'CDC'.
_due_help: Only tenders whose response deadline is between today+min and today+max days. min gives you time to source and quote.
_countries_help: Place of performance country codes, e.g. ['UGA','IND','KEN']. Empty = worldwide incl. US.
_set_asides_help: e.g. ['SBA'] for Total Small Business. Empty = any.
_dashboard_help: The dashboard include list (e.g. 'request') is tuned for embassy pages and blocks most SAM titles, so it is off here. The exclude list still applies.
_keywords_help: Added on top of the dashboard include/exclude keyword lists. Matched on title, agency, NAICS and PSC.
_max_items_help: Max tenders and max awards per email. Extra ones come the next day.
